new.name: transient_count
new.source:
fn transient_count(calls : List(ServiceCall), key : ActionKey) : Int =
  match calls of
    Nil => 0
    Cons(call, rest) =>
      let prior = transient_count(rest, key)
      match call of
        ExecuteCall { key = call_key, execute_outcome = Transient, .. } => if same_key(call_key, key) then prior + 1 else prior
        _ => prior

fn parse_request(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["protocol_version", "task", "input"], [])?
  let version = match get_field(obj, "protocol_version") of
    JInt(n) => ensure(n == 1, "INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
  let _ = version?
  let task = match get_field(obj, "task") of
    JStr(name) => ensure(name == "workflow-recovery", "INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
  let _ = task?
  parse_workflow(get_field(obj, "input"))

fn call_json(call : ServiceCall) : Json =
  match call of
    ExecuteCall { key = key, attempt = attempt, execute_outcome = outcome } =>
      let text = match outcome of
        Applied => "applied"
        Replayed => "replayed"
        Transient => "transient"
      JObj([("kind", JStr("execute")), ("key", key_json(key)), ("attempt", JInt(attempt)), ("outcome", JStr(text))])
    LookupCall { key = key, attempt = attempt, lookup_outcome = outcome } =>
      let text = match outcome of
        Found => "found"
        Missing => "missing"
      JObj([("kind", JStr("lookup")), ("key", key_json(key)), ("attempt", JInt(attempt)), ("outcome", JStr(text))])

new.name: apply_command
new.source:
fn apply_command(sim : Simulator, workflow : Workflow, command : Command) : Result(Simulator, String) =
  match command of
    Advance(by) => if sim.now + by > time_limit() then Err("TIME_OVERFLOW") else Ok(Simulator { ..sim, now = sim.now + by })
    Observe => Ok(Simulator { ..sim, observations = append(sim.observations, [snapshot(sim)]) })
    Restart => if sim.up then Err("PROCESS_UP") else Ok(Simulator { ..sim, up = true })
    _ =>
      if not(sim.up) then Err("PROCESS_DOWN")
      else match command of
        Start(id) => if any(\(run) -> run.id == id, sim.runs) then Err("DUPLICATE_RUN") else
          let run = RunState { id = id, status = Active, cancel_requested = false, steps = map(\(definition) -> new_step(sim.now, definition), workflow.steps) }
          Ok(Simulator { ..sim, runs = append(sim.runs, [run]) })
        Tick(checkpoint) => tick(sim, workflow, checkpoint)
        Crash => Ok(down(sim))
        Cancel(id) => cancel_run(sim, id)
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn execute(service : MockService, key : ActionKey, amount : Int, attempt : Int, failures : Int) : (MockService, ExecuteOutcome) =
  if has_effect(service.effects, key) then
    (MockService { ..service, calls = append(service.calls, [ExecuteCall { key = key, attempt = attempt, execute_outcome = Replayed }]) }, Replayed)
  elif transient_count(service.calls, key) < failures then
    (MockService { ..service, calls = append(service.calls, [ExecuteCall { key = key, attempt = attempt, execute_outcome = Transient }]) }, Transient)
  else
    (MockService { calls = append(service.calls, [ExecuteCall { key = key, attempt = attempt, execute_outcome = Applied }]),
      effects = append(service.effects, [Effect { key = key, amount = amount }]) }, Applied)
